summary: Pointer-based state toggle. Retrieves a child object via virtual call vtable+172; if the pointer is null it short-circuits through vtable+56 with argument 1. Otherwise it clears state via vtable+56 with argument 0, computes a toggle value from the child object's first dword (inverted by the this+0xE4 flag: set means v4==0, clear means v4!=0), re-reads current state via ShortComputation_7720, and on a detected state change calls sub_487260 to set the state and notifies through vtable+44 with argument 1.

local_names.v2: child-object pointer returned by virtual call vtable+172
local_names.v4: first dword of the vtable+172 child object
local_names.v5: computed toggle value, inverted by this+0xE4 flag
local_names.v7: stored toggle value passed to sub_487260
local_names.v6: uninitialized decompiler local used in the state-change comparison

operations.description: Virtual dispatch through the this vtable (this+0x0) at offset +172 (0xAC) to retrieve a child-object pointer into v2.
Early-out: if the retrieved pointer v2 is null, dispatch vtable+56 (obj+0x38) with argument 1 and return its result.
Virtual call vtable+56 (obj+0x38) with argument 0 to clear/disable the state before toggling.
Read the first dword v4 of the child object returned by the vtable+172 call.
Compute toggle value v5: if the this+0xE4 flag is set then v5 = (v4 == 0), otherwise v5 = (v4 != 0). The flag inverts the comparison.
Call ShortComputation_7720(this) to obtain the current state; result stored for change detection.

On detected state change (comparison against the uninitialized decompiler local v6; see unresolved), set state via sub_487260(this, v7) and dispatch vtable+44 (obj+0x2C) with argument 1, returning its result.
Return the result of ShortComputation_7720 when no state change is detected.
